description:
You are a building operations manager at a commercial office building in London. Your IT contractor installed Emoncms for energy monitoring but left the account settings at their defaults (UTC timezone and a placeholder email).

You are currently logged into the Emoncms admin account and viewing the My Account page. Please update the following account settings:

1. Change the **Timezone** to 'Europe/London' (select it from the timezone dropdown)
2. Change the **Email** address to 'admin@greenbuilding.co.uk'

Make sure to save each change so it persists. Use the Save button(s) on the page after making your changes.

The account page is at http://localhost/user/view
Credentials if needed: username 'admin', password 'admin'
